name: Himitsu no Odekake ~Ryoujoku Biru Kara no Dasshutsu RPG~
original_name: 秘密のおでかけ ～陵辱ビルからの脱出RPG～
source:
Little Ayame Sena was playing alone when
she got unexpectedly locked into a building complex.

Men looked her little body up and down.
She was not safe with these strangers, but how to get out......?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ138365.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
小彩女星奈独自玩耍时
她意外地被锁进了一座建筑群。

男人们上下打量着她小小的身子。
和这些陌生人在一起，她并不安全，但如何出去……？

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ138365.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
